name: Shlink
composeYaml:
services:
  shlink:
    image: 'shlinkio/shlink:stable'
    environment:
      - 'DEFAULT_DOMAIN=${APP_URL}'
      - IS_HTTPS_ENABLED=false
      - 'INITIAL_API_KEY=${SHLINKAPIKEY}'
    volumes:
      - 'shlink-data:/etc/shlink/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/rest/v3/health'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
  shlink-web:
    image: shlinkio/shlink-web-client:latest
    environment:
      - 'SHLINK_SERVER_API_KEY=${SHLINKAPIKEY}'
      - 'SHLINK_SERVER_URL=${APP_URL}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15

meta.about: URL shortener with REST API and command line interface. Includes official progressive web application and docker images.
